content.text: I’m glad I’ve been able to keep up with the pace so far. It’s a lot, but incredibly enlightening. I’m starting to accumulate quite a few files in my master prompt—blueprints, SOPs, etc. One of the takeaways from Live Session 4 is to import SOPs into Stage 3.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: I’m glad I’ve been able to keep up with the pace so far. It’s a lot, but incredibly enlightening. I’m starting to accumulate quite a few files in my master prompt—blueprints, SOPs, etc. One of the takeaways from Live Session 4 is to import SOPs into Stage 3.

content.text: I’m very enthusiastic about using the platform created by Hayden; however, the written instructions aren’t sufficient for me to fully grasp how everything fits together. I would really love—perhaps during a live session or in a short 5-minute video tutorial—to see exactly how, for example in Session 4, blueprints and SOPs are imported into Stage 3, so we can see what this looks like in a real-world use case. That would be a huge help.
